svg.title: Mars, Valles Marineris hemisphere
svg.desc: Static vector contours derived from NASA's Viking Orbiter colour mosaic PIA00407, with rust-orange plains, dark terrain, the Valles Marineris canyon system and the north polar cap. The source colour contrast is enhanced; this is a simplified decorative illustration. Credit: NASA/JPL/USGS. Source: https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/global-color-views-of-mars/.
